$comment: One entry per app. scripts/build-apps.mjs turns this list into the app cards on the homepages and the knowledge base, the sitemap lines in robots.txt, and the list of search indexes the site search merges. Run `node scripts/build-apps.mjs` after editing; the publishing workflow also runs it.
